meta.name: astropy
meta.description: Core Python library for astronomy and astrophysics workflows that need Astropy APIs, including units/quantities, coordinates, FITS I/O, tables, time systems, WCS, and cosmology. Use when implementing or debugging astronomical data analysis code with Astropy.

copy.tagline_en: Compute astronomical data with units, coordinates, and FITS in Python

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 Astropy 的 API 帮你写和调试天文数据分析代码,产出单位换算、坐标转换、FITS 文件读写、表格处理、时间系统、WCS 与宇宙学计算等代码。
howto.when: 当你需要写或调试使用 Astropy 的天文代码时触发,例如转换天体坐标、读写 FITS 文件、做宇宙学距离计算等。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude uses Astropy APIs to write and debug astronomical data analysis code: unit conversions, coordinate transforms, FITS read/write, tables, time scales, WCS, and cosmology.
howto.when_en: When you need to write or debug astronomical code that uses Astropy, such as converting celestial coordinates, reading or writing FITS files, or computing cosmological distances.
